prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Initializing Pet Behaviors & Desktop Assets", "style": "highlight"}]}}
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Guided Calibration Flow: Adds an interactive post-onboarding calibration step where users click and drag their newly adopted companion to set its home dock boundary on their desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_placement_calibration"], "new_placement_calibration": {"headline": "Calibrate Pet Desktop Docking", "body": "Click and position your desktop companion to set its initial workspace dock zone.", "layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Position pet companion on screen", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Screen Placement", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Mood Live Simulation Preview: Presents an interactive mood preview on the waiting screen where users can test cursor hover reactions while backend pet creation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "preview", "text": "Live Companion Reaction Preview", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Hover over pet preview to test initial mood cues", "style": "calm"}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Companion Command Shortcut Masterclass Screen: Introduces a new shortcut reference screen before finishing onboarding detailing hotkeys and system tray toggles for hiding and interacting with the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_shortcut_masterclass"], "new_shortcut_masterclass": {"headline": "Pet Hotkeys & System Tray Quick Actions", "body": "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet, or right-click its system tray icon.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Use Alt+P shortcut to toggle pet visibility", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Ready to Launch", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Mode Preview Stage Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen with stage-style interactive archetype cards highlighting companion behaviors before choosing.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "body": "Select between story-driven companionship or lightweight desk buddy mode.", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Companion Mode", "style": "large", "action": "choose", "role": "path_options"}]}}}
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Audio and Interaction Sensitivity Setup Flow: Adds a short audio volume and window collision sensitivity configuration screen to the end of onboarding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_audio_sensitivity_flow"], "new_audio_sensitivity_flow": {"headline": "Set Companion Sound & Window Sensitivity", "body": "Adjust sound cue volume and set how your pet interacts with active application windows.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Test Pet Chime Sound", "style": "plain", "action": "play"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Save & Complete Setup", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Custom Ribbon Selection: Offers users an interactive ribbon badge selector to stamp onto their digital adoption certificate before finalizing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Personalize Your Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Select a commemorative seal to finalize your companion registration.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Desk Companion Seal", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Stamp & Finalize", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Play notification chime when pet is ready", "style": "calm", "action": "play"}]}}
8: [sign_in, layout] Account Sync Dual Panel Layout: Re-architects the sign-in screen into a split layout explicitly explaining pet data synchronization and cross-device account recovery.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Secure Your Pet & Enable Cloud Sync", "body": "Signing in ensures your desktop companion's personality and unlocks remain safe across app restarts.", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "button", "label": "Sign In to Save Pet Data", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Workspace Desktop Fit Guidance Hint: Displays a clear compatibility notice on the story screen reassuring users that pets seamlessly function across single and multi-monitor setups.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Desktop companions support multi-monitor setups and auto-adjust to screen resolution changes.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Compatible with single & multi-monitor desktops", "style": "subtle"}]}}
